skills.name: Audio-rate AM for wave-shaping and FM/ring-like texture
skills.goal: Create complex cinematic textures with audio-rate amplitude modulation: feed a soft waveform (sine/triangle/saw) into a VCA and modulate that VCA at audio rate from another waveform of the same oscillator (self AM / new wave shapes) or a second oscillator (complex sidebands); put the AM depth under an envelope or LFO VCA so dynamics evolve—often reducing the need for a filter.

skills.name: Dual delay: parallel, two-tap, cross-feedback vs ping-pong
skills.goal: Dial cinematic dual-delay motion beyond a basic ping-pong: dual-parallel (independent L/R subdivisions with optional cross-feedback for dense poly-rhythmic space), two-tap tape-head style (long tap feeds short; short has no self/cross feedback for cleaner bounce), recognize ping-pong as 2:1 two-tap, and choose dense (cross-feedback + modulation/diffusion/phase flip) vs discreet (two-tap/ping-pong) stereo population.

skills.name: Hybrid noise+distortion layer separate from sub/harmonic patch
skills.goal: Build a portable hybrid stack: one patch/layer for filtered noise through asymmetric distortion (gritty air/texture) with EQ low-cut and slight top trim, and a separate patch/layer for sub/harmonic tones (e.g. square/WT) so you can retune harmonics or hold a fixed noise pitch without the noise timbre tracking every bass note—then blend; maps to sample/noise + WT + filter hybrid thinking for cinematic beds (not only neuro bass).

skills.name: Mid-side EQ: center the bass, tame mid problems, widen with side mids/highs
skills.goal: Use mid/side EQ on synth/sample/pad layers or mixes: split stereo into mid (L+R mono sum) and side (L−R), high-pass wide bass on the sides to focus low end center, cut resonant/harsh problems only on the mid when they live there, optionally boost the same band on the sides to preserve ambience, and try subtle upper-mid side boosts for depth (not only extreme high shelves for width).

skills.name: Oscillator-as-delay: LFO repeats + stepped pitch-shift grains
skills.goal: Emulate granular pitching delays inside the synth (no delay FX): second oscillator copies the dry WT, an envelope-shaped tempo-synced LFO repeats its level like echoes, global amp release sets feedback/fade length, a fade-in LFO avoids overlapping the dry attack, and a stepped envelope-mode LFO raises pitch by octaves each repeat (e.g. +24 st over quarter-note steps) for sanding granular delay tails—then share formant/WT macros with the dry osc.

skills.name: Parallel filter chains for rhythmic pad motion
skills.goal: Thicken cinematic pads with parallel processing: run dual filters in parallel (e.g. low-pass + band-pass) with independent rhythmic/LFO cutoff motion synced to tempo, stack overlapping bands that a gentle bus compressor tames, and EQ lows after the parallel stack—portable alternative to only insert-filtering a single path.

skills.name: Spectral warp modes: vocode, formant scale, harmonic stretch, smear
skills.goal: Add WT spectral/formant morph delta beyond basic wavetable-position pads: use spectral warp modes—vocode (key-tracked formant shift, vocal/vocoder character), formant scale (more exaggerated vowel/formant moves without key-tracking), harmonic stretch (even harmonic expansion; great for LFO→acid/sci-fi), inharmonic stretch (metallic/bell chaos), and smear (spectral high-pass / additive smear from bottom of table)—then modulate the warp amount for evolving cinematic texture.

skills.name: Wavetable crossfade position + morph/PWM-style shaping
skills.goal: Build evolving WT pads by smoothly crossfading through table frames (not hard digital switches), modulating table position from LFO/mod sources, and using morph-style wave shapers (pulse-width-like morph on squares, mirror/stretch/narrow toward filter-like thinning, optional vintage bit-step) as a portable delta beyond basic WT-position-only pads.
